description.value: Shannon Lake Liquor Store is a neighbourhood liquor retailer in the Shannon Lake area of West Kelowna. It offers a convenient stop for touring cyclists passing through the region to stock up on beer, wine, and spirits. The surrounding Shannon Lake area sits near recreational trails and the lake itself.
